about:
Balance Clothing Company operates from Charleston, West Virginia, where it was founded in 2007 by David Collins. Collins started the business while searching for harmony among the creative process, printing, and design, and the company has grown steadily since its inception.

The firm functions as a custom art agency with an in-house screen printing and vinyl workshop. Its production capabilities span screen printing on apparel, vinyl wrapping for vehicles, boats, buildings, and walls, as well as large-format output such as posters, banners, feather flags, and corrugated plastic signs. The shop also produces rigid signage including 3-D lettering, Lexan and metal signs, trade show booth backdrops, tents, canopies, and a full range of print collateral from business cards to brochures.

Balance serves clients across multiple states, with noted accounts in Chicago, Columbus, Cincinnati, and Hawaii. Its customer base includes businesses seeking branded apparel, vehicle and marine graphics, architectural signage, and trade show displays, as well as individuals looking for custom stickers, banners, and promotional items.

Collins launched the company to unify design and production under one roof, a philosophy that still drives the operation. The team pairs each project with a dedicated artist to tailor files for print, continuously sources new apparel styles and vinyl materials, and emphasizes building long-term relationships over transactional jobs.
